assessment.summary: The resume shows useful automation and remediation work, but does not yet demonstrate the design depth requested for this senior cloud role.
limitations: Text-only review; no original-file parsing or visual layout assessment.
strengths: Python automation has a defined population and before/after preparation time.
Server retirement is a concrete infrastructure contribution.

findings.observation: AWS and Azure tool use is too broad to demonstrate cloud control design.

evidence.quote: Worked with AWS and Azure security tools.

findings.recommendation: Ask which controls and personal actions can be described before adding a guardrail or architecture claim.

rows.rationale: Only text was supplied; original-file parsing is not assessed.
Clear headings and chronology; cloud-relevant evidence could be ordered more strongly.
The opening identifies cloud and vulnerability work but not the senior cloud mandate.
Cloud tool use is stated, but guardrail design and architecture examples are not shown.
Python export automation has a clear before/after; server retirement has a defined scope.
Python and endpoint scope are specific; AWS/Azure controls remain unnamed.
Partnering and automation are shown; senior design ownership is not established.
Required cloud experience is broadly claimed; identity/logging evidence remains unclear.
No demonstrated learning gap warrants a development rating in this review.
